characters.name: Rotlings
characters.description: Alien Blood: They have vibrant purple blood that distinguishes them from the heavenly species' shared black blood color. Bad Guy Bar: The Smiling Dead’s Whale Belly Butcher Shop is essentially this for them. Came Back Wrong: The Black Hand can revive them after death, but never to 100% of what they were. Wounds heal, but damage accrues. This means that they still rot and decay over time. Deathless and Debauched: Most of them have spent the thousands of years since the Black Hand made them undying on endless hedonism and violence. Good Thing You Can Heal: The Mark of the Black Hand grants them this ability.

characters.name: In General
characters.description: Affably Evil: They are all very muchAx-Crazyhedonistswho gladly and excitedly slaughter other people, usually sporting aSlasher SmileandLaughing Madwhile doing so. However, when off-the-clock, they're pretty friendly blue-collar types. So long as you aren't threatening their bottom line, they're sincerely fun company. Animal-Motif Team: Each member has at least oneAnimal Motif, with Mel being associated with birds, Ken being associated with fishes, Mud being associated with snakes, and Breadhead is associated with alligator-snapping turtles. Even Jack has one—in this case, it's rats. Ax-Crazy: Every last one of them is a bloodthirsty maniac who delights in violence. Badass Family: Given that they're a mafia family, this is to be expected. Criminal Found Family: Mel and Breadhead are both Ken's adoptive children. It's also unconfirmed if Ken and Mud are biologically related or adoptive brothers.

characters.name: Melancholy Hill
characters.description: The protagonist of the series, daughter of Ken the Butcher and aMafia Princess. Unknowingly to the rest of the Gaslight District (sans Ken), she happens to be the prophesiedToken Humandestined to weaken the Rotlings by stripping them off of their immortality. Abnormal Limb Rotation Range: Mel is shown to be so flexible that she can bend her head upside down, twice in the pilot. Alien Blood: Just like the angels, she has black blood. This is the primary evidence for anyone to know of her status as the prophesied human, since all the Rotlings have purple blood. Amazing Technicolor Population: Subverted. At first glance, Mel may look like a human with pale-greenish, almost zombie-like skin, not too different from Ken and Mud's skin colors. However, aFreeze-Frame Bonusof an injury that tore the bandages of her arm shows that underneath her bandages, she has a more normal skin tone, which implies she purposefully painted her face in order to blend in and look more like a Rotling. Ambiguously Bi: Mel is shown in aFlashbackreading a spicy magazine depicting a sexy female Rotling on its cover, heavily blushing andbleeding from the noseas a response. Then, she's seen flirting with the male Romeo, even outright telling him she's human, presumably in an attempt to impress him.Her voice actor confirmed it shortly after the release of the pilot.

characters.name: Ken the Butcher
characters.description: The leader of the Smiling Dead and Melancholy's father. Ambiguously Related: It's confirmed that he adopted Mel and Breadhead, but it's unknown if he and Mud are related by blood or not. Anger Born of Worry: He consistently blows up at Mel for her antics, but it's because of her being endangered. Animal Motif: He has a subtle one for fish or aquatic life. Ken's appearance resembles a fish, with his green pallor and the split top of his head looking similar to a head fin. His butcher shop is built into the remains of a dead whale, and his preferred method of killing isstrapping concrete to people's feet and dropping them in the ocean. Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: Despite all the times he loses his temper with Mel, he just wants her to be safe and will go to extreme lengths to keep her that way.

characters.name: Mud
characters.description: Ken's slimy brother and Melancholy's uncle. Accent Adaptation: In the French dub, he speaks with aFrench-Canadian (Québécois)accent instead of an Australian one. Ambiguously Related: He’s supposed to be Ken’s brother, but it’s unknown if they are related by blood or not. Animal Motifs: Snakes. He has a lean, tall build and sometimes appears with his arms disappearing into his coat. He can be seen almost slithering around at some points (like when sneaking up on Joshua from the ceiling), and his sneaky, underhanded mannerisms along with his tendency to swallow objects bring to mind deceptive snakes. He's also seen in the prologue springing out of the toilet through the pipes, which is a common myth people fear snakes do. Awesome Aussie: Has an Australian accent and is by far extremely skilled at handling guns as well as beingcapable of escape car chases.

characters.name: Breadhead
characters.description: Ken's son and Melancholy's brother, Breadhead is a yeast golem who serves as the Smiling Dead's muscle. He's quite childish and eagerly does whatever Ken asks of him. The Alcoholic: He'sveryappreciative when Melsticks a beer bottle in his head, and within a few seconds sticks in several more of his own accord. Though, given his reaction to yeast it could be a liking for fermentation itself rather than the actual alcohol. Animal Motifs: Alligator snapping turtles; it's subtle, but the way he sticks out his bread tongue to trap and kill one of the Angels is very much how alligator snapping turtles use their worm-like tongue to capture prey. Anthropomorphic Food: His entire body is made of bread, with his head being in the shape of a loaf, hence the name. Baritone of Strength: He has the deepest voice of the main cast and is also the biggest and strongest.

characters.name: Jack the Rat
characters.description: A friend of the Smiling Dead who was ultimately drowned by Ken for discovering that Melancholy is a hatched human. He previously worked as Ken’s dishwasher. Advertised Extra: He was featured rather heavily in promotional material prior to the pilot's release. Come his very first scene, he's promptly hunted down and cemented by his former friends. Almighty Janitor: Was just the guy in charge of cleaning the dishes at the Smiling Dead's butcher shop and proves to be quite askilled driverand gunner. That said, hedoesseem to be a bit of an amateur when it comes to defense. Anti-Villain: While he does risk Mel's life, he ultimately only wanted to warn Mud and Breadhead (as well as the rest of the Gaslight District) about the only human left to ensure their way of life isn’t ruined, and he gets punished for it. Combined with the fact that he only uses violence as a last resort and his status as an organ donor, and he arguably borders on being an outrightHero Antagonist. Animal Motifs: Well, it's in his name—rats, considering he wants to rat out the fact Mel is a human.

characters.name: Romeo, Cathey and Syd
characters.description: Other associates of the Smiling Dead who discovered Mel's secret and were cemented. The Generic Guy: All three of them are identical generic rotlings who get no focus other than their job and unfortunate fate. Gossipy Hens: Mel outright told Romeo she was a human, who immediately turned around and told Cathy. Cathy did the same with Syd, all in Ken's earshot, resulting in all three being cemented. Love-Interest Traitor: It's implied Mel told Romeo she was a human as either a gesture of trust or to impress him. Romeo wasted no time telling her secret to Cathy, who would tell it to Syd. Punny Name: Romeo, named after the famous main character of a love story, fucks up his chance at a romance with Mel because he choose to betray her.

characters.name: Diligence
characters.description: The leader of the Virtues. All There in the Manual: The name of the angel who accompanies them is never said in the show, butPartTimeSeagullhas confirmedin a tweetthat its name is Gabriel. Ambiguous Gender: In the Pilot they are voiced by a male voice actor but never referred to with gendered pronouns. Blade Below the Shoulder: They change one of their hands into a blade when they get in a fight with Ken. Bad Boss: They behead one of their men and send them flying into a spike for interrupting them while carelessly stepping on the rest of their men with their sharp heels.

characters.name: Temperance
characters.description: The doctor of the Virtues. They are implied to have history together with Ken. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: Once Ken invades their lab, Temperance at first tries to distract him by hurling their angel companion at him but when that doesn't work they're left pleading with him to reconsider. That doesn't work either. Ambiguous Gender: Their gender is unknown. Ambiguously Evil: They appear in Ken’s flashback as his torturer and seem to be enjoying it. However, in the present, while they do perform what seems to be a painful experiment on a test subject, they go out of their way to apologize before carrying out said deed. Also, unlikeDiligenceand theSmiling Dead, they don’t seem to mean any harm and are merely doing their job. Ambiguously Related: Ken burns a photo of them holding an infant Melancholy, the nearby eggshells suggesting it was taken shortly after she "hatched". It's unclear if they're actually related to Melancholy or if they're just the doctor responsible for delivering her.

characters.name: Joshua
characters.description: A Rotling security guard of the Virtue Corps, who apparently knows Mud. Deep South: He speaks with a noticeable Southern twang. Oblivious to Hatred: At first, Joshua sees Mud as a friend, as when they meet again, Joshua is happy enough to see Mud that he hugs him and calls him "Muddy Buddy", completely unaware that Mud doesn't feel the same way, with the latter being very quick to shoot Joshua in the head point-blank before proclaiming his hatred. After he gets back up, though, he quickly gets the picture and fights without hesitation. We Used to Be Friends: He greets Mud like an old friend, but Mud hates his guts due to aNoodle Incidentthat happened at least 5,245 years ago.Mud: I hate ya! I'll always hate ya! I WILL NEVER FORGIVE YOU!!

characters.name: Angel Mother
characters.description: The massive sentient bird that lays the eggs from which the angels allied with the Virtue Corp are born. Every 10 thousand years a human is also born from her egg. Absurdly Elderly Mother: She looks like a withered crone. Justified, since she’s likely been alive for thousands of years. Alien Blood: Just like other angels (and Mel), she bleeds black compared to Rotlings' purple. Angelic Abomination: A cross between this andAnimalistic Abomination, as she is an ancient Angel that looks like a vulture with cross-iris eyes, a halo, and gigantic claws. Abusive Parents: She's Mel's biological mother, although she has no qualms about trying to break her physically and mentally as well as using her to destroy the Rotlings—cutting her arm to see her bleed and beating her up until she passed out is an example. She also sees Mel's siblings as nothing more than minions she could control.

characters.name: Ramiel
characters.description: Adorable Abomination: Despite being anAngel, the chick looks like a small puffball made of feathers with a halo over it. All There in the Manual: Its name is never said in the pilot, butthe Gaslight District merch store◊temporarily revealed that its official name is Ramiel. Cephalothorax: Its body looks like a round feathered head on top of skinny bird legs. Deathbringer the Adorable: The name Ramiel means “God has thundered”. Seems unfitting for a cute little puffball, but if it grows up to be as dangerous as its kindred this may be a case ofKiller Rabbit. Our Angels Are Different: Like the other angels in the series, the Angel is a crowlike creature instead of the traditional humanoid depictions of angels.

characters.name: The Black Hand
characters.description: Eyes Do Not Belong There: It's depicted with what appears to be an eye in its palm. Greater-Scope Villain: It is responsible for granting Rotlings immortality and has an entire religion dedicated to it. That being said, it doesn't make a physical appearance in the pilot, with Heaven and especiallyDiligenceandAngel Motheracting as immediate threats. Power Tattoo: Its symbol is branded somewhere on the bodies of every Rotling, being the source of their immortality. Even the Virtues have them, as Temperance's can be seen on his brain as Ken is eating it. It’s even shown that entities that aren’t Rotlings or Virtues like Breadhead can also possess it.
